subject: Budget Ordinance Revisions
overview: The subcommittee reconvened to review proposed revisions to the comprehensive budget ordinance with the Chief of Staff and Finance Director. The committee approved a motion directing the administration and members to continue reviewing draft language regarding the general fund framework and budget needs assessments ahead of a future meeting.

items.title: Budget Ordinance Review
items.summary: The subcommittee and administration officials reviewed proposed revisions to the budget ordinance, focusing on the quarterly financial reporting schedule, preliminary budget hearing timelines, disaggregating departmental fixed cost increases, and how to address non-general fund and capital needs assessments within existing administrative capacity.

items.title: Direction on Ordinance Drafts and Next Steps
items.summary: Approved a motion for the administration and subcommittee members to review current drafts, consider framework points for Articles 5 and 6, and circulate written responses ahead of the next meeting.
